subject: Hosted API integration — engineering deep-dive & calendar coordination
messages:
From: Laura Stein <laura.stein@medlinkhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tools)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found Redwood's latency and batching approach compelling. We'd like to move to a technical, engineering-led deep-dive focused on integration patterns for the hosted API: SDK usage, streaming responses, and function/tool calling (we're particularly interested in reliability and how to surface errors for downstream services).

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute session for the MedLink platform + backend teams (3-5 engineers + one security SME)? Our priorities are:
- concrete SDK examples (Python + Node) and recommended client-side patterns
- streaming best practices for partial responses and reconnects
- function/tool calling examples and error handling semantics
- specifics around audit logs and token retention for compliance

I've attached a short priorities spreadsheet with our agenda items and suggested attendees. Prefer week of Oct 11 if possible — open to times in the afternoons PST.

Thanks,
Laura Stein
Director, Platform Engineering
MedLink Health
Attachment: medlink-hosted-integration-priorities.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Laura Stein <laura.stein@medlinkhealth.com>
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tools)

Hi Laura — great to hear the demo resonated. Happy to run the deep-dive. Thanks for the priorities sheet; that helps a lot.

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue Oct 12, 1:00–2:30pm
- Wed Oct 13, 3:00–4:30pm

Suggested attendees from our side: myself (serving runtime + routing), Ava Chen (client SDKs + streaming), Soojin Lee (security & audit logs).

Draft agenda (60–90m):
1) 10m intro & goals (Laura + Karthik)
2) 20–25m SDK patterns (Node + Python) — connection reuse, backpressure, helper libs
3) 20m streaming & recovery strategies — partial outputs, reconnect, ordering guarantees
4) 15m function/tool calling demo — design patterns, error semantics, retry policies
5) 10–15m compliance & logging (SoJin) — audit trails, token retention, redaction options
6) 10m next steps + mutual action items

Couple quick questions so we tailor the session:
- Which SDK languages do you want prioritized? (you listed Python + Node, confirm)
- Any constraints on session recording? (our CS and engineering notes are useful for follow-up)

If either slot works for you we'll send a calendar invite (Google Calendar link + pre-read).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Stein <laura.stein@medlinkhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tools)

Hi Karthik and team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the agenda — looks perfect. One change: a few of our backend engineers are booked on Oct 12 afternoon and would prefer Oct 14 if possible. Does Thu Oct 14 10:00–11:30am PST work for Redwood?

Also, a small ask on the compliance piece: can Soojin be prepared to speak to the specifics of audit log retention windows, where logs are stored (customer vs Redwood), and options for providing log extracts for our SOC review? If you have a one-page summary you usually share, that would be helpful as a pre-read.

We can record the session and share notes; please mark anything sensitive for internal Redwood review.

Best,
Laura
Laura Stein
Director, Platform Engineering
MedLink Health
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Laura Stein <laura.stein@medlinkhealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tools)

Laura — Thu Oct 14 10:00–11:30am PST works from our side, I can cover the compliance items you mentioned. I'll attach a one-pager that outlines: storage locations, retention configurations, export formats we support, and typical turnaround for evidence requests.

On the technical side I'll coordinate with Ava on a short demo showing:
- client SDK streaming example (Python) with reconnect logic and how we expose partial tokens
- function/tool calling: example flow + best-practice idempotency keys and error codes
- quick note on KV cache behavior to set expectations for stateful sessions

Ava — can you prepare a short code sample (Node + Python) illustrating streaming + function-call handoff and share it as a pre-read? That will let us jump into architecture questions.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-hosted-arch-reqs.pdf

Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Hosted API engineering deep-dive — Thu Oct 14 10:00–11:30am PST

Laura — confirmed. I've created a calendar invite and included the pre-read assets and agenda. Google Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-12345

Pre-reads attached: redwood-hosted-arch-reqs.pdf (compliance one-pager), sample SDK snippets (Node + Python), and our recommended streaming/reconnect checklist. We'll plan to record the session and share the recording + action items afterward.

Agenda will follow the draft above; please let me know if you want us to add a short ramp for your SREs on connection pool sizing / batching tradeoffs.

Looking forward to it.
—Karthik
